description: Injects a threshold/plateau effect into one feature: it influences the outcome up to a point, then its effect levels off.
business_question: For one column, increasing its value is linked to changes in {OUTCOME_COL} only up to a point. After that, further increases make little difference. Which column is it, and around what value does that happen? Return your answer as: column_name, value
ds_question: One feature has a threshold effect on {OUTCOME_COL} — it matters up to a point, then its effect levels off. Which feature, and at approximately what value does the effect plateau? Return your answer as: column_name, value
